title: Half Day Luxury Boat Tour in Key West with Snorkeling
blurb: Enjoy the Thrill of the open sea and the comfort of top class amenities, ideal for sunbathing, sightseeing or simply relaxing with your group exploring with stops like Fort Zachary Taylor Historic State Park, U.S. Coast Guard Cutter Ingham Maritime Museum, Smathers Beach, Southernmost Point of your list.
